entries.title: Universal Hub V4 — Friends and expanded native controls
notes: A dedicated Friends tab with all Roblox friends, online and playing filters, name search, game artwork, profiles and fresh-presence joining.
A smaller default window with readable typography, and a rebuilt Players profile with solid card surfaces and scrolling identity and action sections.
Native Fling controls with player autocomplete, style, duration, standing mode, live status and an always-available Stop action.
New character tuning, spin, animation speed and freeze, camera zoom and sensitivity, atmosphere, local platform and inventory controls, with scoped restoration.
A new glass interface with inline tools, searchable features, section navigation, themes, and responsive controls.
Player profiles and targeting, movement and visual tools, remembered games, and session utilities.
Script discovery across ScriptBlox, RScripts, and RobloxScripts, with an Auto source, saved scripts, and full listing details.
Main and Lite chat compatibility, attachment viewing, Spotify, AI, MCP, and diagnostics in the Main interface.
Stable AFK camera with scene-adaptive grading and subject focus; effects are removed when you resume.
First-install asset downloads, Main-specific changelog, and GitHub test-channel reload and teleport support.
Asset downloading now shows only the animated Main logo, without progress bars or status text.
Removed the demonstration thunderstorm alert; the overview shows real weather alerts only.
